# Overview
Gitboard serves as a local orchestration dashboard for managing code-change workflows across GitLab and GitHub. It synchronizes local development state with remote forge activity, providing visibility into CI status, open Merge Requests/Pull Requests, and failed job triage.
## Agentic Grounding
Agents interacting with this repository operate within a local-first development context. The system leverages existing CLI tools (`gh`, `glab`, and `git`) to bridge the gap between remote forge metadata and local worktree states.
### Core Objectives (via Slice Objective Ledger)
The product's operational goals are defined by the synchronization of remote forge signals with local developer environments, ensuring that CI failures and pending reviews are surfaced directly within the local workflow.
### Typology & Roles
The system architecture is organized into functional packages that manage:
Forge connectivity and authentication via `gh` and `glab`.
Local worktree and checkout state synchronization.
Real-time dashboarding of CI/CD pipeline health.
Triage workflows for failed jobs and pending repository changes.
This grounding provides a map of the `gitboard` ecosystem, focusing on the interaction between local git state and remote forge APIs.
